scope: Exact reviewed airline-authored GDS source URL admission in lib/validation/records.js only within operational paths
findings: Official airline host validation remains unchanged. Non-airline-host URLs are allowed only when they exactly match an independently reviewed immutable source-provenance entry with the same airline, source_reconciled status and airline_authored_gds_notice sourceKind.

The identity comparison preserves scheme, host, path and every query parameter/value; query order is normalized and a fragment is ignored. No general HanjinSabre or Travelport host exception is added.

HTTPS, absent credentials and default HTTPS port checks run before both admission paths. Wrong airline/category/boardID, duplicate injected boardID, lookalike hosts, HTTP and credentialed URLs are rejected by regression tests.

URL admission remains structural validation only. Existing source provenance reconciliation still independently binds month, amount, currency, original band, applicability dates and allowed route pairs.
The existing optional link checker validates each redirected URL through the same source validator; arbitrary GDS redirects are not trusted.

No API handlers, collectors, CI workflow, dependency manifests, Vercel configuration, advertising/analytics/consent files or protected affiliate integrations changed. Protected file hashes were compared with bbd070f.
MyRealTrip URLs in currently changed tracked public JS/HTML/JSON files were also compared with the base commit and are unchanged.
